title: Athena by Shoplazza
claim: Product Hunt: Athena by Shoplazza — An orchestrator agent for your entire commerce stack
why_good: An orchestrator agent that ties together a merchant's whole commerce stack — real pain for operators juggling many tools.
value: Per-merchant subscription or GMV-based fee to e-commerce operators; the wedge is one control panel over fragmented tools.
risk: Backed by Shoplazza (platform-tied); Shopify and the platforms can build native orchestration and lock it in.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: Athena by Shoplazza —— 编排你整个电商技术栈的 agent。
zh.why_good: 一个把商家整个电商栈串起来的编排 agent——对同时用一堆工具的运营者是真实痛点。
zh.value: 向电商运营按商家订阅或按 GMV 抽成;切口是一个控制台管碎片化工具。
zh.risk: 背靠 Shoplazza(绑平台);Shopify 和各平台能做原生编排并锁定。
